name: search_and_sequence_places
description: Search for places (attractions, restaurants, points of interest) near a destination, and sequence a list of chosen places into a geographically sensible visiting order to minimize backtracking within a day's itinerary.

action.description: 'search' to find candidate places by free-text query; 'sequence' to reorder a chosen list of places geographically.

query.description: Free-text search query, e.g. 'temples in Kyoto'. Required for action 'search'.

bias_latitude.description: Latitude to bias search results toward (e.g. the destination's center). Optional for action 'search'.

bias_longitude.description: Longitude to bias search results toward. Optional for action 'search'.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return. Defaults to 5. Only used for action 'search'.

places.description: List of places to sequence geographically. Required for action 'sequence'.

ordered_places.description: Present for action 'sequence'. Same shape as the input 'places', reordered.

error.description: Present only if the request failed.
